action_items: note: existing browser check 'no-paypal-or-artificial-warmup' now fails because the Billing feature was intentionally added to the sidebar this iteration; that check encoded the PRE-billing requirement ('no PayPal UI exposed') which the current acceptance_matrix explicitly supersedes with billing criteria. Not a regression/bug -- the check itself is obsolete and was excluded from this report's checks[]. Recommend the main agent either delete/retire that check or rewrite it to assert 'no purchase/checkout action is rendered while checkout_enabled=false' (which the new billing-catalog-and-safe-status check already covers).
